summary: Backend-only re-test focused on the new 'Share track' viral discovery feature. 35/35 pytest cases passed: 17 new share tests + all 18 prior auth/library regression tests. New endpoints fully verified: POST /api/library/share/{song_id} (auth, idempotent slug, 404 unknown, 400 no audio, 401 unauth), GET /api/share/{slug}/info (public, view increment, 404 invalid), GET /api/share/{slug} (public HTML 200 with og:audio + og:image + twitter:player meta + <audio src=...> element + view increment), DELETE /api/library/share/{song_id} (auth, removes share -> 404 on subsequent GETs, per-user scoping enforced — User B cannot affect User A's share, distinct slugs per user for same song_id), and slug persistence across re-import.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with deleted=0 when no share exists (silent no-op). Idempotent but not strictly REST; 404 might be more conventional. Non-blocking — frontend can rely on the returned 'deleted' count.
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event hooks (carry-over from iter 1).

critical_code_review_comments: Share slug generation uses secrets.token_urlsafe(6)[:8] with up to 5 retries on collision and a unique index on slug — safe.
Unique compound index db.shares (user_id, song_id) correctly enforces 'one share per (user, song)' and powers idempotency.

_resolve_share() increments views via $inc on every call (info + HTML) — matches the request spec; returned 'views' in /info is incremented value (views + 1 from pre-update doc) which is acceptable since the GET itself counts as a view.
Share HTML correctly HTML-escapes title/artist/tags/urls via html.escape — XSS-safe.
All MongoDB projections exclude _id and password_hash — clean responses.
Share endpoints properly scoped by user_id on writes; public reads only by slug — correct trust boundary.
seed_data_creation: Each share-test module run registers two transient users (test_share_a_*@test.app and test_share_b_*@test.app) and cleans up their libraries on teardown. No persistent state left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share-feature regression lives at /app/backend/tests/test_share_api.py. Re-run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest backend/tests -v. Both test files self-seed and clean up, safe to re-run. pytest.share_slug_a / share_slug_b are module-level slug carriers between test classes — preserved test order within the file matters (TestCreateShare -> TestShareInfo -> TestShareHTML -> TestReimportPersistence -> TestShareScoping -> TestRevokeShare).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in the share feature.
